query:
UPDATE feeds
            SET last_fetched_at = ?,
                next_fetch_at = ?,
                consecutive_failures = 0,
                backoff_until = NULL,
                last_etag = ?,
                last_modified = ?,
                updated_at = ?,
                title = COALESCE(?, title),
                description = COALESCE(?, description),
                site_url = COALESCE(?, site_url)
            WHERE id = ?
